breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。

master.definition_en: Froelich syndrome is characterized by obesity and hypogonadism due to a hypothalamic-pituitary disorder. This syndrome appears to affect males more commonly. The term 'Froelich syndrome' is rarely used today.

aliases_zh: 儿童交感神经系统恶性肿瘤
curated.category: 恶性肿瘤 / 儿童颅外最常见实体瘤
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 婴幼儿最常见的颅外恶性实体瘤，被称为“儿童肿瘤之王”：低危婴儿型甚至可自发消退；但约半数确诊即属高危组（>18月龄伴MYCN扩增或广泛骨/骨髓转移），进展极快，可突发哑铃型肿瘤压迫脊髓致急性截瘫、巨大腹膜后肿块致肠梗阻/呼吸窘迫或骨髓衰竭致命。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 预后呈现极端的“冰火两重天”：低中危组经单纯观察、手术或温和化疗，5年生存率高达90%–98%；高危组即便经历诱导化疗+手术+自体干细胞移植+放疗+抗GD2免疫治疗+异维A酸维持的“全套强化治疗”，5年生存率仍仅约50%左右。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GLOBOCAN未单列神经母细胞瘤；全球儿童年发病率约10/百万（<15岁），虽仅占儿童肿瘤约7%–8%，却贡献了约15%的儿童肿瘤总死亡

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国无单列全国死亡统计；推算中国每年新发神经母细胞瘤约3,000–4,000例，其中高危组占比超50%
annual_deaths_china.source: 国家儿童医学中心(北京儿童医院/上海儿童医学中心)队列报告

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 婴儿期最常见恶性肿瘤，90%在5岁前确诊（中位年龄17–18个月，Orphanet ORPHA:635）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 推算年新发约3,000–4,000例，MYCN基因扩增约占20%、ALK突变/扩增约占10%–14%

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 椎旁‘哑铃型’肿瘤经椎间孔压迫脊髓致突发双下肢无力、拒站或尿潴留：属于儿童肿瘤急症，立即静脉地塞米松冲击并急诊启动化疗（比急诊椎板减压更少脊柱畸形后遗症）或神经外科减压; 2) 新生儿4S期巨大肝转移致腹腔室隔综合征、下腔静脉回流受阻及呼吸衰竭：立即ICU呼吸支持并急诊低剂量化疗或小剂量肝区放疗减容; 3) 视性眼阵挛-肌阵挛-共济失调综合征(OMS)：予激素/IVIG/利妥昔单抗免疫调节。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 口服ODC抑制剂依氟鸟氨酸(Eflornithine, Iwilfin)于2023年12月获FDA批准用于抗GD2治疗后维持，将高危患儿4年无事件生存率进一步推升至84%; 2) 靶向GD2的第三代CAR-T细胞疗法(GD2-CART01，意大利Bambino Gesù团队发表于NEJM)在多线复发难治神经母细胞瘤取得63%客观缓解率，国内多项GD2/B7-H3 CAR-T临床亦呈高缓解态势; 3) COG ANBL1531 3期研究正验证ALK抑制剂洛拉替尼联合一线化疗用于ALK驱动高危患儿。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) MYCN扩增及复发耐药高危患儿长期治愈率仍仅约50%以下，复发后几乎无标准可治愈方案; 2) 抗GD2单抗及细胞疗法价格高昂且未入国家常规报销目录，普通家庭经济负担极其沉重; 3) 尚无针对MYCN转录因子的直接获批靶向药。

master.definition_en: A rare neurodegenerative disease characterized by extrapyramidal symptoms (rigidity, tremor, bradykinesia) and dementia, typically beginning in the fifth or sixth decade of life and progressing to a vegetative state with pelvicrural flexion contractures within few years. The disease is endemic to the Pacific island of Guam.

master.definition_en: A rare developmental anomalies syndrome characterized by severe intellectual disability and distal hypoplasia of digits, particularly of thumbs and halluces, with nail aplasia or hypoplasia. Facial dysmorphism with a pseudo-myopathic appearance has been reported, which may include high anterior hairline or low frontal hairline with central cowlick, flat forehead, ptosis, hypertelorism, downslanting palpebral fissures, epicanthal folds, ears with thick helices, broad depressed nasal bridge with anteverted nares, short columella, long philtrum, high-arched palate, broad mouth with thick vermilion border of the upper or the lower lip and downturned corners. Marked hypotonia, seizures and global developmental delay have been reported, associated with autistic spectrum disorder manifestations in some patients.

master.definition_en: Glioependymal/ependymal cyst is a rare central nervous system malformation defined as a subarachnoid, supratentorial, interventricular or intraspinal, sometimes intracerebral or intramedullar cyst with an internal ependymal lining, possibly surrounded by glial tissue. It may be an incidental finding or may present at different ages with clinical features depending on its size and location. It may distort adjacent brain structures and cause macrocephaly, ventriculomegaly, hydrocephalus, focal neurological signs and other signs and symptoms. In some cases, it is associated with other cerebral malformations (e.g. corpus callosum agenesis, polymicrogyria, heterotopias).

master.definition_en: Accessory tricuspid valve tissue is a rare, congenital, atrioventricular valve malformation characterized by fixed or mobile accessory tissue on the tricuspid valve, usually associated with other complex congenital heart anomalies (atrial septal defect, ventricular septal defect, transposition of great arteries, tetralogy Fallot). It may present clinically with systolic murmur, dyspnea, cyanosis, depending also on accompanying congenital heart anomaly.

master.definition_en: Panner's disease is an osteochondrosis of the capitellum of the humerus, characterized by involvement of the dominant upper limb and onset before the age of 10 years. It results from lateral compression injuries of the elbow typically occurring in children practicing sports such as baseball and throw. It should be distinguished from osteochondritis dissecans of the capitellum, occurring later, in adolescents. Management is symptomatic and consists in reducing the activities of the affected elbow for a prolonged period of time. Prognosis is good.

master.name_en: autoinflammation with episodic fever and lymphadenopathy
master.definition_en: An autosomal dominant immunologic disorder characterized by onset of recurrent episodes of unexplained fever beginning in early infancy. The episodes occur in a cyclic pattern with a frequency of every week or every few weeks and a duration of several days. Patients have accompanying lymphadenopathy, and some may have hepatosplenomegaly. Patient serum shows increased levels of inflammatory cytokines and chemokines, including IL6 and TNF, consistent with abnormal activation of the innate inflammatory system. Treatment with anti-IL6R antibodies may result in clinical improvement.
